source.name: 433FC – Saudi Pro League 2026/27 Shirt Sponsors
source.note: Table of each club's main shirt sponsor and kit manufacturer; the page says the details reflect confirmed 2025/26 contracts carrying into 2026/27.

source.name: Al Riyadh Club – Tameeni official sponsor of Al Riyadh (riyadhclub.sa)
source.quote: أعلنت إدارة نادي الرياض عن توقيع عقد رعاية جديد مع منصة “تأميني” الرائدة في مجال وساطة التأمين الطبي وتأمين السيارات
source.note: Club announcement that Tameeni is a sponsor (English: the club management announced a new sponsorship contract with the Tameeni platform, a leader in medical insurance brokerage and car insurance). It documents the sponsorship, not a shirt placement: no text source confirms Tameeni on the 2026/27 home shirt (Tameeni appears on the chest of the club's 2025/26 away player shirt), and the launch and retail images show no sponsor print, so it is listed as a partner.

source.name: 433FC – Saudi Pro League 2026/27 Shirt Sponsors
source.note: Same table: Black Panther is listed as Al-Riyadh's kit manufacturer for 2026/27. The league's kit gallery photos also carry the Black Panther logo.

summary: Black Panther home kit (unchanged design from 2025/26). 433FC lists Science Technology as main shirt sponsor and Black Panther as kit maker for 2026/27; the club announced Tameeni as a sponsor in August 2025, but no source confirms a shirt placement for Tameeni on this kit, so it is listed as a partner. The launch and retail shirt images carry no sponsor print and show the front only, so no source supports a Stars Smile (or any) back placement on this shirt; that listing was dropped. The sponsor list is not complete.
